crossRefs.note: I am dark, but lovely, you daughters of Jerusalem, like Kedar’s tents, like Solomon’s curtains.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love…

I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, that you tell him that I am faint with love.
His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

people.name: Jesus

translations.web: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
